title: The Executioners
description: some cool mega-weapons that are kinda balanced.
body:
uh uhm so basically it has some very cool weapons including:

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Staff of Dominance: Earth Form, Angel Form, Sword Form, Spear Form, And Shield Form (The Staff Of Dominance is a multitool made by God, it can turn into (With transformative templates) a sword, a spear, and shield. The perqued glass bulb contains God's Orb of Creation, the object that started it all. This Staff is made of Angelic Steel, an Angelic Gold & Nickel Alloy, while the bulb is made of perqued glass, which is just like tempered glass, although it's quite stronger.)

The Sickle of Radiance (Crafted by the first man of god, Adam. This Sickle glow in the dark, and emits a dim, iridescent light.)

The Glave of Divinity [I know realize it is not a glaive/glave, but infact a new weapon that doesn't exist. I'm, just calling it a glave :p] (Created by god's second in command, an Archangel named, adequately enough; Divinity. The Glave is powerful enough to rival the staff. Made with angelic gold.)

The Gauntlets of Heat (Forged by the Archangel of Fire, to set enemies on fire when attacked.)

The Axe of Destruction (Yep! A destructive axe, no way! Destruction Embodied, made of Angelic Tungsten & Angelic Steel. Any organic material that comes in contact with the axe will rapidly decay.)

The Trident of Aqua (Aqua's Trident, like a normal trident but it does a lot more damage. Made with Angelic Prismarine.)

The Gauntlets of Cold (Forged by the Archangel of Ice, to encase enemies in ice.)

The Greatsword of Love (It's a greatsword. If you hit an entity other than a player, it will not attack you for a few minutes.)

The Scythe of Death (No Description Available)

The Staff of Fate [right click for negative, poison + aquatic positive, or positive effects] (No Description Available)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

It also contains some armor:

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Cloak of Death (makes you look really cool + is better than netherite)
